text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The design looks something like this, I guess.
The fabric is ready, so all that's left is making it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to think that girl is already old enough to run in regional meets.
She was so small just a little while ago, and now she's representing her club team!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if they'll like the banner?
I hope it gives them the push they need to take 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With a smile full of tenderness, Cesario works on the cheer banner. And that was how she ended up staying up late into the night—
